name: Gorgonzola
siboNotes: As an aged cheese with minimal lactose, gorgonzola is well-tolerated by most SIBO patients. The aging process breaks down lactose naturally.
preparationTips: Store wrapped in wax paper rather than plastic to maintain proper moisture
Bring to room temperature 30 minutes before serving for best flavor
Crumble over salads or melt into low-FODMAP sauces
Pairs excellently with low-FODMAP nuts and fruits
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in calcium for bone health
Source of beneficial probiotics from aging process
